page.overview:
Who is Gaddison?

When first approaches , she reports that the east gate to is clear. However, she quickly recognizes , calling him a sight for sore eyes. She realizes that must be the that brought to the .

However, notes that has not changed at all in 100 years, but she dismisses it as she does not have time to chat. She is supposed to watching the as part of her job, but she asserts that she can talk to later.

Once has calmed , notices the clear sky wonders whether managed to stop the . She is still wary of the water level of the , even after has stopped spouting water. She shares some of the history of , such as being its 100 years ago, and wonders if managed to fire at it.

During the "" , can ask about her name. When tells her that is looking for someone like her, she asks what he needs. However, since he is looking for someone who can act as a priest, will refuse him. She considers herself a blood-stained soldier who could never be a priest, but says that could help him.
